excellent_fit.label: Excellent Fit
excellent_fit.description: High alignment across budget, coverage, and risk thresholds.

good_fit.label: Good Fit
good_fit.description: Satisfactory matching with minor compromises on preferences or budget.

fair_fit.label: Fair Fit
fair_fit.description: Functional matching but with notable gaps in budget/coverage limits.

unsuitable.label: Unsuitable Plan
unsuitable.description: Fails basic affordability guidelines or essential rider protection standards.
